response.passage: The annual school play at St. Jude’s Academy is a tradition that brings the entire community together. This year, the drama department decided to perform a historical drama titled 'The Silent Fort'. The play is scheduled for 15th December, which is exactly two weeks after the final exams conclude. Mr. Khanna, the head of the drama club, chose this date to ensure that students could focus entirely on their rehearsals without the pressure of academics. Because the auditorium stage was undergoing renovations, the team had to move their practice sessions to the open-air basketball court. This change in location proved difficult for the lead actor, Rohan, who struggled to project his voice against the evening wind. Despite these challenges, the students are excited to showcase their hard work. The school principal, Mrs. Sharma, has promised a special trophy for the best performance of the night. Everyone is working tirelessly to make the event a success, hoping to impress the parents and guests who will fill the seats.
